verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an email service with a developer platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents the Microsoft Graph REST API, usable from 'any language or platform capable of sending HTTP requests', and the web-based Graph Explorer. Neither is an official command-line tool: the API is a developer building block and Graph Explorer is a browser tool, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
